notes: CIRCLE, using preliminary SSRS Voter Poll data, reports 65% of young men voted for a Democratic House candidate, compared with 77% of young women (https://circle.tufts.edu/youth-vote-choice-demographics-2026-midterms).
NBC's national exit poll shows voters 18-29 (10% of the electorate) backing Democrats 72% to 25%, while men overall are split 49% to 49% (https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2026-elections/exit-polls).
NBC's page has no age-by-gender table. Its Georgia page shows only 2024 and 2020 exit polls and no 2026 poll data.
